In this lively late-night installment, host Seth Meyers delivers his trademark comedic opening monologue and current-affairs segments, blending sharp political satire with pop-culture humor before bringing out his celebrity guests.

Guest Appearances
✨ Emilia Clarke
  • The internationally known actress appears as herself to promote her upcoming work (likely linked to her recent TV and film projects).

  • During the interview, Clarke shares anecdotes from her acting career and interacts warmly with Seth’s humor.

  • She even jokes on the show about behind-the-scenes moments — including humorous bits about learning lines in other languages for roles and playful commentary that fans enjoy online.
✨ Connor Storrie
  • Actor Connor Storrie makes his late-night talk show debut on Late Night with Seth Meyers in this episode.

  • Best known for his role in the popular series Heated Rivalry, Storrie chats with Seth about his work and rising fame.

  • He shares entertaining stories from the set — including how background actors reacted to him during filming and amusing moments involving language challenges on set.

  • This appearance marks a high-profile promotion moment for Storrie as his show gains wider attention.
Tone & Highlights
  • Seth’s Monologue: As always, Seth opens with witty takes on the latest news, combining sharp observational humor with political and entertainment commentary.

  • Guest Interviews:
    • With Emilia Clarke, the conversation ranges from her acting experiences to light-hearted banter about roles, languages, and pop-culture moments.

    • With Connor Storrie, Seth explores his journey breaking into late-night television and discusses fun behind-the-scenes stories.
  • The vibe is relaxed and engaging, striking a balance between promotional discussion and spontaneous humor — typical of Meyers’ late-night style.
